Messages.Author: Gordon Fischer
Messages.Body:
This is Nick Lee and Gordon Fischer and we have a series of questions
related to our game tonight.

1) Can Thadius Zho's ability to remove one blood send a vampire to torpor?

2) Can multiple Weather Controls be played in one combat round?

Thanx.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
ghfi...@landen.math.uwaterloo.ca (Gordon Fischer) writes:

>1) Can Thadius Zho's ability to remove one blood send a vampire to torpor?

No. Removing blood that isn't there has no effect (same as for steal
blood strikes, cryptic mission, etc.)

>2) Can multiple Weather Controls be played in one combat round?

Sure.
